title: NASA’s Webb Shows How Supernova Dust Chronicles Star Evolution
caption:
NASA’s Webb Telescope has mapped the dust in the supernova remnant Cassiopeia A. The results suggest the star’s interior was in a state of chaotic flux just hours before it exploded.

Source: Science - NASA’s Webb Shows How Supernova Dust Chronicles Star Evolution
